'''June 2000 Boxboro tournament (sealed overdrive)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed (overdrive, non-sanctioned) held in Boxboro, MA on 23 June 2000. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d938">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-boxboro-ma-6-23-hoth-scenariod938/ boxboro-ma-6-23-hoth-scenario], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-boxboro-ma-6-23-hoth-scenariod938/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Boxboro, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
